respCode.description:
ISO 8583 Response Code indicating the outcome of the authorization request. This API always returns HTTP 200 — the `respCode` field is the authoritative indicator of whether the transaction was approved or declined. Refer to Visa/Mastercard specifications for the full list of values.
| Code | Meaning | |------|---------| | `00` | Approved | | `05` | Do Not Honor (Declined) |
